lesson.subject: general-knowledge
lesson.title: General Knowledge Check-In: Where Am I?
lesson.summary: A friendly tour of maps, inventions, space, nature, healthy living and countries, so we can see what you already know.
learning_objectives: Show what I know about continents, oceans and capitals
Show what I know about inventions and history
Show what I know about space, nature and healthy living

blocks.markdown:
This is a **check-in**, not a test.

It helps us find out what you already know about our world so your lessons can be a perfect fit.

Have a go at everything!

Earth has **7 continents**: Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe and Australia/Oceania.

There are **5 oceans**: Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic. **Asia** is the biggest continent and the **Pacific** is the biggest ocean.

blocks.alt: A map shows where places are. A compass shows which way is north.
blocks.caption: A map shows where places are. A compass shows which way is north.

blocks.title: The 5 oceans
blocks.caption: The Pacific is the biggest. The numbers are just the order they are listed in.

blocks.markdown:
People have invented things that changed the world: the **wheel**, the **printing press**, the **light bulb**, the **telephone** and the **computer**.

History is the story of what happened long ago. We learn about it from objects, buildings and writing.

scenes.caption: Long ago, people invented the wheel.
Later came the printing press, which made books.
Then the light bulb, to light up the night.
Now we have the computer and the telephone.

question.prompt: Which invention helps us make light at night?

blocks.title: Inventor's challenge
instructions: Think of a problem in your home.
Draw an invention that could fix it.
Explain your invention to a grown-up.

blocks.markdown:
Our Solar System has **8 planets** that go around the Sun. Earth is the third planet from the Sun. The **Moon** goes around the Earth.

The **Amazon** is the biggest rainforest. The **Sahara** is the biggest hot desert.

scenes.caption: The Sun is in the middle.
Planets travel around it. Earth is the third planet.
The Moon goes around the Earth.

question.prompt: How many planets are in our Solar System?

blocks.alt: A rainforest like the Amazon and a hot desert like the Sahara.
blocks.caption: A rainforest like the Amazon and a hot desert like the Sahara.

blocks.markdown:
A healthy body needs a **balanced diet**: fruit, vegetables, protein, grains and water.

At your age you need about **9 to 11 hours of sleep** and plenty of exercise. Washing hands and brushing teeth are good habits.

blocks.alt: Sleep well, eat well, move your body and keep clean.
blocks.caption: Sleep well, eat well, move your body and keep clean.

question.prompt: A balanced diet means eating only one kind of food.

blocks.markdown:
People around the world speak thousands of languages. Every country has a **flag** and a **capital city**.

Paris is the capital of France and Tokyo is the capital of Japan. Islamabad is the capital of Pakistan and London is the capital of the United Kingdom.

blocks.alt: The flags of Pakistan, the United Kingdom, France and Japan.
blocks.caption: The flags of Pakistan, the United Kingdom, France and Japan.

blocks.prompt: What is a fact you know about another country?
blocks.answer_markdown: Any fact you can tell is great. Ask a grown-up to check it with you.

points: Inventions change how we live, and history tells us what happened long ago.
The Solar System has 8 planets and the Moon goes around the Earth.
A balanced diet, sleep and exercise keep us healthy.
Countries have flags and capital cities.

blocks.markdown: When you are ready, start the quiz. It has 15 questions and takes about 15 minutes. Do your best!
